snippet.title: [Ember and Blade] Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
"A Soul Torn in Two, Truth Beyond Deaths"

Meet Ember and Blade, where darkness and light wage an eternal battle.
Cut through nightmarish hordes, master celestial blessings, and shape your fate.

The demon hunter Fenrix forged a pact with an angel, binding himself between life and death. 
Now, he dives into the abyss to unveil the truth, defy fate, and carve his legend.


[Ember and Blade — Coming to PC on Early Access in 2025]
